question: Who founded Shantiniketan near Bolpur on 22 December 1901?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rabindranath Tagore:

 
 
• His first poem was published in the Amrita Bazar Patrika and then he wrote ‘Banaphul’ and ‘Bhanusinher Padavali’.
 
• He founded Shantiniketan near Bolpore in December 1901.
 
• He wrote Gitanjali, for which he was awarded the Nobel Prize in 1913.
 
• He also founded Vishwa Bharati University.
 
• In 1919, he renounced the knighthood granted by the British crown after the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre. 
 
• He composed National Anthem for two nations
 
 
• India–Jana Gana Mana
 
• Bangladesh–Amar Sonar Bangla
